about.title: Hi, I’m Cristian.
about.description: I’m a software developer from Guatemala, focused on building thoughtful web and mobile experiences. I bring frontend development and UX design together to create interfaces that feel clear, useful, and easy to use.

fact_1.title: Web Development
fact_1.text: I build web interfaces with a focus on clear navigation, responsive layouts, and thoughtful visual details.

fact_2.title: Mobile Apps
fact_2.text: I develop mobile experiences that bring useful features and intuitive interactions together across different screen sizes.

fact_3.title: UX Design
fact_3.text: I approach design by understanding what people need, simplifying interactions, and refining the details that make an interface easier to use.

fact_4.title: Artificial Intelligence
fact_4.text: I’m exploring AI and data science to understand how data can inform decisions and help solve practical problems.

about.exploration: I’m currently pursuing an IMBA at National Tsing Hua University in Taiwan, connecting my software development background with a growing interest in business and innovation. My curiosity also takes me into data science, game development, and augmented reality.
about.personal: Away from the screen, I find inspiration in music, art, and time outdoors. That balance shapes the care and creativity I bring to my work.
